description: Set the required HTTPS endpoint on the project's Prod application using its Prod environment ID. Return its server-only signing secret; install it in Prod application secrets without logging it. This disables receiving until mail_webhook_verify succeeds. The app stores mail in its own database, then responds 2xx.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: mail_webhook_set
